newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Goodale sets 1997/98 wheat, barley prices.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Goodale sets 1997/98 wheat, barley prices.

text.p: Canadian Wheat Board Minister Ralph Goodale on Wednesday set the CWB's 1997/98 (Aug/July) initial prices in wheat, durum wheat, feed and malting barley, a Government of Canada statement said.
Initial prices are government-backed first-payment prices of 70 to 80 percent of the CWB's estimate of world grain prices.
No1 Canada Western Red Spring Wheat's initial price effective August 1, 1997, will be C$130 a tonne, compared with the original initial price in 1996/97 of C$190 a tonne.
No1 Canada Western Amber Durum is C$179, versus C$170.
No1 Canada Western Feed Barley is C$95, versus C$137.
Special Select Canada Western Two-Row Barley (malt) is C$149, versus C$180, the statement said.
Prices are in-store Vancouver or St. Lawrence River.
